businesses.business: professional baseball team and mixed-use real estate

offering_description.value: Owns and operates the Atlanta Braves Major League Baseball club, selling tickets, sponsorships, concessions and media rights to fans, businesses and broadcasters. Also develops and operates The Battery Atlanta, a mixed-use district of retail, dining, office, residential and entertainment next to the ballpark, leasing space to tenants.

primary_products.value: game tickets; merchandise; food and beverage concessions

primary_services.value: baseball entertainment; media rights licensing; sponsorship and advertising; commercial real estate leasing; live event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: baseball fans buying tickets, merchandise and concessions, district visitors; B2B: corporate sponsors, broadcast partners, retail, office and residential tenants

end_markets.value: professional sports; media and broadcasting; live entertainment; commercial real estate; hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: tickets, merchandise, food and beverage at the ballpark; licensing or royalties: local and national media rights, MLB revenue sharing; other: corporate sponsorships and advertising; rental or leasing: rent from office, retail and residential tenants in the mixed-use development
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; other; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates the ballpark and mixed-use development, selling to fans, sponsors and tenants; brand owner: owns Braves franchise brand, licensing media rights and merchandise

geography_served.value: US national: Atlanta area operations, fanbase and media distribution across the Southeast and nationally

specialization.value: related lines: baseball franchise operations and adjacent mixed-use real estate around the ballpark

distribution_channels.value: own locations: ballpark ticketing, concessions, team stores and The Battery Atlanta; online: online ticket and merchandise sales; partners / resellers: regional sports and broadcast partners carrying games

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: MLB league rules and agreements, zoning, alcohol licensing and food safety regulation
